name: Media · drill-in · asset-detail · alt-generate-failed
why: UX-H-09 — '✨ Generate' flips to 'Generating…', flips back, and says nothing: AssetDetailOverlay.tsx:270-289's catch body is a comment only. Without OPENAI_API_KEY every AI job fails on 'Missing credentials' (root CLAUDE.md). The fix asks for an inline error under the field, or hiding the affordance entirely when AI is not configured — this board draws the first and names the second as the alternative.
